$comment: A pass that died before writing its checkpoint. It is still CHARGED, and it must not look like a completed pass with a zero-duration checkpoint. Written for the ruling that the charge happens at start.

workerExit.note: host slept; the worker never returned

assertions: charged true with checkpointSha null: a crash costs a pass and buys no checkpoint
the receipt carries the cursors from BEFORE the pass, so a restart re-reads exactly the events it lost
status computes freshness from the last COMPLETE checkpoint, so this pass does not make the workstream look younger
no code path may treat a null checkpointSha as an empty checkpoint
